svg.aria-label: How setup works: you give a brief or answer 9 questions and approve the plan; SETUP_PROMPT.txt drives Claude Code through phases A to F (interview and propose, docs and rules, version research, skeleton and verify); the result is rules and memory, a .claude folder with commands, agents and a hook, and a skeleton with CI.

g.text: When setup finishes, _kit/ is deleted: only adapted files stay, and every later session starts with /start-session.
